name: bada-topos
description: Bada Topos — algebraic topology rebuilt as the quantum circuit of a thought center, on the Bada language. A thought center is a simplicial complex (vertices = elements, edges = associations, faces = understandings); a thought is a chain with one qubit per simplex; the boundary operator is a CNOT circuit |c>|0> -> |c>|dc|; ideas are homology classes ker d / im d. A cycle filter post-selects closed thoughts from a superposition and reads dim Z_k off the measurement probability; a Hodge-Laplacian quantum walk shows the idea (harmonic) component of a thought is invariant in time. Self-contained HTML app.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
